scope: Actual six production C# files compiled and executed against narrow Unity API test doubles; NOT Unity Editor/Quest.

results.name: Five contacts: phone strings and unique radio channels address the same objects
Independent phone/frequency buffers and both modes reach the same voice
Incoming true means accepted; a busy second incoming cannot overwrite first
Natural voice completion ends even while independent feedback still plays
Decline a ringing call, then outgoing voice does not inherit loop
SOS preempts connected or ringing calls and schedules restart exactly once
1001 typed in either mode works while busy and FREQ permits four digits
Empty, unknown and missing audio paths never count as connected
Playback that never starts gives explicit failure, not normal completion
Global listener pause is not treated as finished speech
Popup follows real incoming/connected/ended states and a three-second timeout
Crewmate random calls use one coroutine after many accepted and rejected attempts
Invalid fixed frequencies safely fall back; valid fixed frequencies remain
Contact buttons use current mode and old name wrapper remains callable
